changelog:
✨ New Features
• Copy text: Add option to select text of descriptions and posts
• Navigation bar: Add "Show Watch later button" setting
• Niconico comments: Add reset button to quick settings
• Niconico comments: Add video type selection
• Translate live chat: Add DeepL provider and fix Google rate limiting issue
• Remove the new setting dot once the setting is opened or changed

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YouTube
• Google and Yandex voice-over translation (VoT)
• Video, audio and thumbnail downloader with Save to device
• Customizable preset settings for a Premium-like experience
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Spoof video streams: Video opened from the search results can load forever when another video is fetched at the same time
• Feed view count: Badge of a card that enters from the bottom is hidden between the loading spinner and the view count, when the view count is on a row below the channel
• Force fullscreen landscape: Setting is shown on large screens with Android 16 and later, which ignore the orientation it requests
• Hide ads: Ads are shown in the Shorts feed when a channel is in the ad whitelist
• Hide layout components: Comment box, composer and reply buttons open the channel guidelines sheet with "Hide Community Guidelines"
• Hide layout components: Pages of the Explore menu, such as Movies and Memberships, are empty or miss their shelves with "Hide horizontal shelves"
• Minimal miniplayer: Bar keeps a larger gap above the snackbar than the snackbar keeps above the navigation bar
• Minimal miniplayer: Snackbar covers the bar instead of moving it up like the default miniplayer
• Morphe snackbar: Increased snackbar queue timeout to 5 seconds
• Niconico comments: Make quick settings scrollable in landscape
• Playback speed: Holding a Short does not play it at 2.0x when a default Shorts speed is set
• Playback speed: Holding a Short does not play it at the custom tap and hold speed when a default Shorts speed is set
• Premium-style queue: Fix dragging videos to the end
• Remove background playback restrictions: Video does not resume when a Short opened over it is closed
• Theme: App crashes on launch with Android 8.0 when the device uses a night configuration and the app uses the light theme
• Theme: Status bar shows white icons on the light theme colors other than white
• Snackbars are shown with an empty space above the navigation bar, as high as the system navigation buttons
